name: AWS Activate
summary: Cloud credits and technical support for early-stage startups building on AWS, from first prototype to Series A and beyond.
amount: Up to US$200,000 in AWS credits (amount depends on eligibility, see official page)
next_steps: Check eligibility and credit tier on the official Activate page
Apply with your project details and a working prototype

name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
summary: Azure credits, OpenAI and GitHub benefits, and technical support for startups building products on Microsoft cloud.
amount: Up to US$150,000 in Azure credits (maximum, see official page)
next_steps: Check eligibility on the official Founders Hub page
Apply and link your product and company details

name: NVIDIA Inception
summary: Free cloud credits, preferred pricing on NVIDIA hardware and software, technical courses and investor networking for AI and deep tech startups.
amount: Varies, see official page (cloud credits, preferred hardware pricing)
next_steps: Confirm your company is incorporated and under 10 years old
Apply with a clear NVIDIA technology use case

name: Cloudflare for Startups
summary: Cloudflare platform credits for funded technology startups, scaled by funding tier.
amount: Up to US$350,000 in credits over one year, by tier (US$10,000 to US$350,000)
next_steps: Check your funding tier against the official page
Use a company email that matches your domain

name: MongoDB for Startups
summary: MongoDB Atlas credits and support for software startups that are Series A or earlier and less than seven years old.
amount: Varies, see official page (Atlas and Voyage AI credits by tier)
next_steps: Confirm the company has a single software product
Apply with company name, domain and LinkedIn

name: Y Combinator
summary: Three-month accelerator in San Francisco for early-stage technology companies, with mentoring and a network of investors.
amount: Varies, see official page (investment terms are set per batch)
next_steps: Apply before 2 Nov 2026 at 8pm PT (3 Nov 2026 12:00 AWST)
Prepare a short video and a clear product description

name: Entrepreneur First
summary: Programme for technical and ambitious people to find a co-founder and build a company from an early idea, with an equity-free grant at the ideation stage.
amount: Up to US$250,000 initial investment once a company is formed (equity-based)

deadline.note: See apply.joinef.com for the current intake

next_steps: Apply at apply.joinef.com with your idea or background
Check the intake dates on the apply page

name: GitHub Secure Open Source Fund
summary: Funding, security training and support for open source maintainers to make their projects more secure.
amount: US$10,000 per project, paid in tranches
next_steps: Confirm your project has an open source license and a clear governance structure
Check that GitHub Sponsors supports your region before applying

name: Emergent Ventures
provider: Mercatus Center at George Mason University
summary: Fast, flexible grants for individuals and small teams with ambitious projects that can create large benefits, open to applicants worldwide.
next_steps: Read the programme criteria on the official page
Apply with a short description of your project and its benefit

name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
summary: Google Cloud credits for startups. The Start tier is for unfunded startups with a working MVP founded in the last 24 months; the Scale tier is for startups with verifiable pre-seed to Series A funding, founded in the last 5 years.
amount: Start tier US$2,000; Scale tier up to US$200,000 over 2 years, up to US$350,000 for AI-first startups (funding proof needed for Scale)
next_steps: Check which tier fits on the official page
Have your 18-character Google Cloud billing account ID, a company website and a matching company email ready
Apply once the product has a live website

name: Google for Startups Accelerator
summary: Equity-free accelerator of about 10 weeks to 3 months with mentoring and Google technical support, run as regional cohorts each year (North America, Europe and Israel, Southeast Asia, Africa, MENA and others). Mostly for seed to Series A tech startups, often with a minimum team size.
amount: Equity-free; no cash, mentoring and Google product support

deadline.note: Regional cohorts open yearly; the 2026 rounds have closed, watch the regional pages for 2027 windows

next_steps: Pick the regional program that matches your company location
Check team size and stage on its entry criteria page
Watch for the next application window

name: Techstars Accelerator
summary: Three-month mentorship-driven accelerator for early-stage startups, run in many cities. Techstars invests USD 220,000 and takes common stock plus the value of an uncapped MFN SAFE.
amount: US$220,000 (US$200,000 uncapped MFN SAFE plus US$20,000 for 5% common stock)

deadline.note: Each city program has its own intake, see apply.techstars.com

next_steps: Pick a program and check its intake dates
Check the current terms in the Techstars help article
Prepare a team profile and traction summary

name: Antler Residency
summary: Pre-seed investor that runs residencies in many cities (Asia Pacific, Europe, Americas, Middle East and Africa). Individuals can join without a team or idea to find co-founders; solo founders may enter but Antler has a strong bias towards co-founding teams and usually does not invest in solo founders after the program.
amount: Pre-seed investment for equity, amount and terms vary by location (see the location page)

deadline.note: Cohort start dates per city, see the Antler cohort list

next_steps: Choose a location and read its residency page
Apply through the form on the Antler apply page
Plan to find a co-founder during the residency

name: Oracle for Startups
summary: Oracle Cloud program open to startups anywhere that are not yet acquired or listed, with sign-up credits and a two-year discount. A separate, selective Startup Growth Engine offers larger credits.
amount: US$500 credits on joining, US$1,000 more on request, 70% discount on Oracle Cloud for two years; Growth Engine credits US$5,000 to US$60,000
next_steps: Create an Oracle Cloud account via Join Oracle for Startups
Request the extra credits after you start consuming
Check the terms for the Startup Growth Engine on the official page

name: DigitalOcean Hatch
summary: Cloud credits for new startups that have raised US$10 million or less, with priority for AI-native startups. Consultancies, agencies and web or app development shops are not eligible. Credits are used over 12 months.
amount: Varies by award, shown in the onboarding email (usual limit US$10,000 per month)
next_steps: Create a DigitalOcean team account with a company email and website
Check the partner list, or apply with Other as partner
Apply before building on a paid plan, credits are for new accounts only
